biological_mechanism.cellular_pathology: Age-dependent progressive degeneration of dopaminergic neurons (PPL1 cluster loss ~30-50%) causing classic Parkinsonian bradykinesia and locomotor suppression
biological_mechanism.lif_intervention: Structural ablation/silencing of 40% of dopaminergic projection neurons into descending motor pathway, causing severe drop in forward driving rate
biological_mechanism.primary_citation: Park et al., 2006 (Nature, DOI: 10.1038/nature04623); Clark et al., 2006 (Nature, DOI: 10.1038/nature04659)

provenance.simulation_engine: LIF neural network simulation on Google Colab
